prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: internal layout draft for a research-paper neural architecture schematic, not experimental evidence. Draw a clean, original, wide landscape CVPR-style flat vector-looking diagram on white, restrained pastel blue/orange/purple, crisp arrows, highly readable English text. Title 'J11: Detail–semantic citrus instance segmentation'. Three top groups: 'Non-CSP encoder', 'One-pass scale fusion', 'Task-separated heads'. RGB input enters 'RGB + luminance + local contrast' then 'S2D stem' then sequential stages C2(s4,32), C3(s8,64), C4(s16,96 with Differential context), C5(s32,160 with SPPF); P1 stem is s2,16. Encoder uses JDown and JStage, not C3k2. Fusion has THREE independent rows: P3 = Fuse(C3,C2,C4), width64 stride8; P4 = Fuse(C4,C3,C5), width96 stride16; P5 = Fuse(C5,C4), width128 stride32. P3/P4/P5 feed separate Box, Class, and Mask-coefficient towers. A P2=C2 soft-foreground/visible-boundary scene branch modulates INPUT FEATURES of CLASS tower only, not scores, box or coefficients. High-resolution mask decoder receives projected P2 32ch, projected P3 32ch upsampled to P2 then added, upsampled again to stride2 and concatenated with projected P1 16ch; DW3+PW outputs32 mask prototypes atstride2. Coefficients and prototypes form visible instance masks. Use dashed blue detail bypass arrows from P1/P2, dashed purple scene arrow to CLASS INPUT only. Two bottom module insets: source softmax fusion with weights summing1; differential context D=softmax(Q+K+^T)-softmax(Q-K-^T), D1=0 (D itself NOT generally zero),16 pooled memory positions and a zero-start residual. Exact constraints: NO FPN/PAN loop, NO HRNet persistent parallel branch, NO Mamba, NO LSKA, NO amodal mask completion, NO fake sample photographs/predictions, NO accuracy claims or results plots, NO logos. Use geometric feature tensors and blocks only. Footer 'Architecture candidate; accuracy and GPU speed require experiments'. Keep structure rigorous and uncluttered.
